godpathSays.line: 📺 A person, maybe 20s, with thick glasses killed a red moon rising between the trees, breathing out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 6 rounds, 34 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 A person, maybe 20s, with thick glasses killed a red moon rising between the trees, breathing out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 6 rounds, 34 taken.

🔥 The fire settles. the person in their 20s, with thick glasses has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A red moon rising between the trees, breathing — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 50s breathes "Say that again — slower." Mara breathes "The fire feels smaller now." ◈ A person, maybe 20s, with thick glasses came back different. Quieter. Surer. The wild is writing on them.

A person, maybe 30s leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a red moon rising between the trees, breathing. Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a red moon rising between the trees, breathing: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
